note: The Qwen3 layer's attention layout on the Hopper warp-group cell: query, key and output sequence-major ([batch, sequence, head, head width]), two query heads per key head, causal, the carrier's full head width in one warp group. Both of the score's operands read the head (the query as h, the key as h / 2), and a rule that refused any coordinate both operands read as a fragment row or column took the chunk tier off this layout; only a coordinate composed with the reduction index is refused now.

let f32 v0 = 0.0883883461356163
in0 = load scaled_dot_product_attention_mask_fill_c[0]
in1 = load scaled_dot_product_attention_mask_zero_c[0]
for a0 in 0..512:
    for a1 in 0..16:
        for a2 in 0..512:
            for a3 in 0..128:
                in2 = load x1[0, a2, a1 / 2, a3]
                in3 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a3]
                f32 v1 = multiply(in3, in2)
                acc1 <- add(acc1, v1) over a3
            v2 = multiply(acc1, v0)
            v3 = select:
                in1 when a2 <= a0
                in0 when a0 < a2
            v4 = add(v2, v3)
            acc0 <- maximum(acc0, v4) over a2
        for a2 in 0..512:
            for a5 in 0..128:
                in4 = load x1[0, a2, a1 / 2, a5]
                in5 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a5]
                f32 v5 = multiply(in5, in4)
                acc3 <- add(acc3, v5) over a5
            v6 = multiply(acc3, v0)
            v7 = select:
                in1 when a2 <= a0
                in0 when a0 < a2
            v8 = add(v6, v7)
            v9 = subtract(v8, acc0)
            v10 = exp(v9)
            acc2 <- add(acc2, v10) over a2
        for a6 in 0..128:
            for a7 in 0..512:
                for a8 in 0..128:
                    in6 = load x1[0, a7, a1 / 2, a8]
                    in7 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a8]
                    f32 v11 = multiply(in7, in6)
                    acc5 <- add(acc5, v11) over a8
                v12 = multiply(acc5, v0)
                in8 = load x2[0, a1 / 2, a7, a6]
                v13 = select:
                    in1 when a7 <= a0
                    in0 when a0 < a7
                v14 = add(v12, v13)
                v15 = subtract(v14, acc0)
                v16 = exp(v15)
                v17 = divide(v16, acc2)
                v18 = multiply(in8, v17)
                acc4 <- add(acc4, v18) over a7
            transpose_2[0, a0, a1, a6] = acc4
